title: Screening for Intrapartum Fetal Compromise Using Placental Biomarkers
official: Screening Della Compromissione Fetale Intrapartum Mediante Utilizzo Dei Marcatori Placentari
summary: This study aims to investigate the association between placental markers (sFlt-1, PlGF, and the sFlt-1/PlGF ratio) and intrapartum fetal compromise, assessed on the basis of the cardiotocographic tracing.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Gestational age ≥ 32 weeks
* Obtaining informed consent for participation in the study and for the processing of personal data
* Pregnant patients with an indication to perform placental marker testing as part of routine clinical practice
* Patients who will deliver at the Obstetrics Units of the participating centers

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Absolute contraindications to vaginal delivery (placenta previa, vasa previa, placenta accreta, previous myomectomy)
